method: Read-only JSON/text parsing and ast.parse of captured source. No received runner/test/fixture/driver/COMSOL code was executed or imported.
path_base: Paths are relative to the directory containing CASE_RESULT_MAP.json.
line_number_convention: One-based inclusive line numbers in the captured raw files.
count_note: 103 step observations = RED-L 27 + RED-R 11 + GREEN 65. The same 38 new test functions occur in both a RED step and GREEN; this is not 103 distinct tests.
limits: Static consistency verification of supplied records, not an independent execution of the test suite.
RED summary lines contain node IDs only; exception evidence is in the associated failure sections.
No skip/xfail/xpass/collection/internal-error/warning outcomes were reported in the raw logs; this does not claim unrecorded activity is impossible.
GREEN captured negative-test errors and timeout output are distinct from outer-step metadata errors/timeouts.
GREEN zombie IDs 1238 and 1319 are also recorded as reaped; the runner constructs the zombie list from its pre-reap observation table.

steps.runner_exit_status_limit: Outer shell exit status is not separately captured; 1/1/0 follows from metadata plus runner return logic.
